Type: white rectangular dining table
Use: dining, working at a table; dining room, kitchen, home office
Style: minimalist, Scandinavian, contemporary
Materials: white laminated top with rounded corners, white powder-coated tubular steel frame
Colors: white, all-white
Shape: thin rectangular top on two looped steel trestle legs with diagonal braces and a center rail, light and open, medium size

Goes with: light wood chairs, colorful accents, white walls; Scandinavian kitchens and bright dining rooms
